newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves drop $15.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves drop $15.8 mln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves fell $15.8 million from January 17-24 to a total of $9.87 billion, the central bank said Tuesday.
It said the figure for January 24, the latest date for which official reserve levels were available, marked a 20.5 percent increase over Colombia's net reserves in January 26, 1996.
But the figure was down 0.3 percent compared to December 30, 1996, when net reserves reached a record-high of $9.89 billion.
